breakdown.rationale: A detailed, itemized list of physical accessibility measures is disclosed (ramps, lowered reception desks, evacuation chairs, tactile flooring/Braille signage, induction loops, accessible toilets) with named certified sites (Amli, Haridwar, Mumbai/Bengaluru R&D centres, Head Office), but no digital accessibility measures (website/app, screen readers) are mentioned at all.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose digital accessibility measures such as website/app WCAG conformance or assistive technology provided to employees.

breakdown.rationale: A named Equal Opportunity Policy and a distinct named 'Disability Accommodation Policy' are disclosed, along with a described accommodation process (voluntary self-disclosure leading to tailored accommodations), though no detail on the accommodation policy's actual provisions or turnaround commitments is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Publish the substantive content of the Disability Accommodation Policy, including any response-time commitments for accommodation requests.

breakdown.rationale: Specific PwD headcounts with gender and permanent/other-than-permanent breakdowns are disclosed (34 employees, 100 workers), but no percentage of total workforce or year-over-year trend is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD headcount as a percentage of total workforce and show trend across reporting years.

breakdown.rationale: The filing states PWDs are treated fairly 'across recruitment' under the Equal Opportunity Policy, but no hiring targets, attainment figures, or disability-specific outreach channels are disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Publish a specific PwD hiring target and report attainment, along with any disability-focused sourcing channels.

breakdown.rationale: Turnover-rate and parental-leave return-to-work/retention tables are disclosed but not broken out by disability status; no PwD-specific attrition or tenure data is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose attrition/retention rates specifically for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: Board and KMP representation data covers only gender; no PwD presence in senior or management roles is disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD representation within management/leadership bands.

breakdown.rationale: No disability-specific training or sensitization programs for employees are disclosed; DEI narrative references general 'diversity awareness' capability-building for leaders but not disability-specific content.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose any disability-awareness/sensitization training delivered to employees or managers.

breakdown.rationale: No ongoing PwD-specific culture practices (ERGs, flexible-work commitments, accommodation response-time commitments) are disclosed beyond the general accommodation policy already captured under Policy.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe ongoing PwD-focused culture initiatives such as employee resource groups or accommodation turnaround-time commitments.

breakdown.rationale: Only generic grievance-redressal channels for all employees/workers are described; no satisfaction or grievance data specific to PwD employees is disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Track and disclose grievance/satisfaction metrics specific to PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: Specific named sites are stated to be certified for accessibility and the company states an explicit aim to certify 100% of sites against the RPwD Act's Minimum Mandatory Standards, but full attainment across all sites is not yet claimed and no WCAG digital conformance level is stated.
breakdown.recommendation: Report full RPwD Act Minimum Mandatory Standards certification attainment across all sites and any digital accessibility (WCAG) conformance level.
